content: Letter 6, to Ghiyās Aḥmad Niẓām, presumably Sayyid Amīr Niẓām al-Dīn Aḥmad Ṣāʿidī (who controlled Isfahan during Iskandar's rise, per MK's footnote): Ibn Turka asks the amir to look into the situation of Sharaf al-Dīn Yaʿqūb Qāżī and of a group of Sufis sent to him (TMN/MS pp. 3-4; also in microfilm 227).
